_note: SAMPLE menu for preview. Every dish, price, allergen and flag must be confirmed with Gracefield before launch.

_schema.name: Dish name (required)
_schema.image: Path to a square photo (optional; row reflows without it)
_schema.alt: Photo description (required when image is set)
_schema.allergens: List, e.g. Peanuts, Fish, Wheat, Egg, Sesame
_schema.flags: Any of: Popular, New, Weekends only, Sold out
_schema.home: true = show in the homepage favourites (keep to 6 or fewer)
_schema.farm: true = made with produce or meat from the Gracefield farm (shows a From our farm tag)
